{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Check for missing values in flipper_length_mm
missing_flipper = df['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum()
print(f"Missing flipper_length_mm values: {missing_flipper}")

# Check if missingness in flipper_length_mm is related to species
missing_by_species = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].apply(lambda x: x.isnull().sum())
print(f"Missing values by species:\n{missing_by_species}")"}
